points.description: States that all dimensions except the first must be specified (the first dimension may be omitted/left blank).
points.partial_credit: Half or more (2-3 marks) if the student says the size of the dimensions must be given but is vague about the first being omitted, or says only the first may be left out without saying the rest are required.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying all dimensions except the first (in any wording, e.g. 'all but the first', 'the column size is needed for a 2D array'). Part marks for a vague or half-correct statement, such as 'the later dimensions' sizes' without the first being excluded, or 'the first can be left blank' alone. No marks for answers like 'all dimensions' or 'only the first', or unrelated talk about arrays.
